title: Truth-Love-Stewardship-Accountability Grid

# Truth-Love-Stewardship-Accountability Grid

| Question | Notes |
|---|---|
| Truth: Is the claim accurate and the authorship honest? |  |
| Love: Who is helped, ignored, manipulated, or harmed? |  |
| Stewardship: What happens to attention, skill, time, privacy, and power? |  |
| Accountability: Who is responsible and how can the decision be reviewed? |  |

Evidence classification: direct biblical principle / canonical synthesis / prudential judgment / unsettled technical claim.
